R7BB-grouse-drive-0001.name: 760 m NW of Bissett Creek
R7BB-grouse-drive-0001.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R7BB-grouse-drive-0001.parkWhat: pull off on Wildmare Creek Rd (gravel road)

evidence.t: Road: Wildmare Creek Rd, 4.2 km stretch.
100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
4 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
14 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

seasonRows.notes: MU 7-31 is not listed in the Region 7B sharp tailed grouse rows (my reading of the table).

plan: Drive: from District of Hudsons Hope, about 46 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Canyon Dr, Hwy 29 (Beattie Dr), Hwy 29, Hwy 97.
Park: 55.72049, -121.84064, pull off on Wildmare Creek Rd (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk or drive slowly: the Wildmare Creek Rd stretch, 4.2 km one way. About 85 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-31, Region 7B. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-05, closures 2026-10-16.
R7BB-grouse-drive-0001.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 7-31: about 4,381 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.79 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
